notes: the first isnad («فقد رويته عن محمد بن الحسن ... عن عيسى بن أبي منصور») is al-Saduq's statement of his route to Isa's reports, with no saying: not read as a route (rule 4), rule 11
the second isnad carries the saying: Ibn Abi Ya'fur heard it from Isa, who speaks to him; the Imam is present, not speaking, so he is not a link (rule 6)
«رضي الله عنه» after محمد بن الحسن is a blessing: left out
